name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Income support of ₹6,000/year paid in 3 installments to landholding farmer families.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Financial assistance for construction/purchase of a pucca house for eligible families without one.
benefit: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh / direct assistance up to ₹1.2-2.5 lakh

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for the girl child with attractive interest rate and tax benefits.

name: National Social Assistance Programme - Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension for elderly citizens living below the poverty line.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Free LPG gas connection to women from below-poverty-line households.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
description: Scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropout at class 9-12.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

name: Disability Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension for persons with 80%+ disability from economically weaker households.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Working capital loan for street vendors to restart their businesses.
benefit: Collateral-free loan up to ₹50,000 in three tranches

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Cash incentive for pregnant and lactating mothers to support nutrition and safe delivery.
benefit: ₹5,000 cash incentive for the first living child, in installments

name: Integrated Child Development Services (Anganwadi Nutrition Support)
description: Supplementary nutrition, health check-ups, immunisation referrals, and pre-school education for young children at the local Anganwadi centre.
benefit: Free daily nutrition and health monitoring for children up to age 6

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
description: Free nutritious mid-day meal for children studying in government and government-aided schools.
benefit: One free nutritious meal every school day

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension after age 60 for workers in the unorganised sector.
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
description: Free assistive devices — walking sticks, hearing aids, spectacles, wheelchairs — for senior citizens from poor households.
benefit: Free assistive living devices based on age-related impairment

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
description: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for SC/ST/OBC students pursuing education beyond class 10.
benefit: Full tuition fee coverage plus monthly maintenance allowance

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans to support women entrepreneurs setting up new (greenfield) enterprises.
benefit: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore
